question: Add a context parameter to the GetMeta() method on RNode in sigs.k8s.io/kustomize/kyaml/yaml. RNode is the core exported type for representing and manipulating Kubernetes YAML resource documents in kustomize. Changing the signature from GetMeta() (ResourceMeta, error) to GetMeta(ctx context.Context) (ResourceMeta, error) breaks all downstream callers that invoke manifest.GetMeta() without passing a context, including Helm's post-render workflow.
